run_f_gold_search: run f_gold to search for a target value in an array where adjacent elements differ by 1
test_f_gold_with_cases: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct index or -1 results
refactor_f_gold_to_f_filled: refactor the TOFILL placeholder f_filled to match the f_gold search algorithm behavior
review_f_gold_optimization: review f_gold which skips indices by abs(arr[i] - x) instead of incrementing by 1
summarize_f_gold_algorithm: summarize f_gold which finds element x in array arr of size n using optimized linear search
